posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked: Specifically, the “Draw” phase of a Hero turn is optional, in that it reads “You may draw a card”. Whenever a card says “You may draw a card” it means just that. Whenever a card says “Draw a card” then you must comply.
posts.raw: Specifically, the "Draw" phase of a Hero turn is optional, in that it reads "You [b]may[/b] draw a card".  Whenever a card says "You may draw a card" it means just that.  Whenever a card says "Draw a card" then you must comply.
